newsitem.title: UK: Hewden up on optimism despite results drop.
newsitem.headline: Hewden up on optimism despite results drop.

text.p: Shares in British plant hire and construction equipment firm Hewden-Stuart Plc jumped nearly 10 percent on Wednesday after the company issued an upbeat statement for the year despite a drop in pre-tax profit.
Shares in the company traded 12-1/2p higher at 138p by 0845 GMT on volume of 111,120 shares.
"They are basically in line with what people were looking for, but there was a good, positive trading statement which is the main reason why the shares went up," said Mark Hake, analyst at UBS.
Hewden-Stuart said pre-tax profit for the year to January 31 fell to 29.45 million stg from 36.25 million a year earlier.
The company said it anticipated an improvement in trading conditions for the next year in line with broader industry forecasts with the recovery in the housing market likely to be sustained.

"Given that we are getting a decent recovery coming through in housebuilding and there are signs that engineering may pick up next year, the background is getting better for all plant hire companies," Hake said.
